trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy and this one unlocks by itself. There is no online trophy and no DLC trophy, so one single-player playthrough is enough. Budget around 200 hours: most of it goes to the 100% checklist behind A Long Road, so follow the roadmap step by step.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: about 200 hours to platinum; difficulty 4/10.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the end of it. It is automatic story progress, so it cannot be missed. If you are just starting out, simply keep playing the main story.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. The trophy actually pops once you start Chapter 2, after the first mission, What's in the Bag? Just keep following the story; there is nothing extra to do.
trophies.quote: GTABase: pops once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It unlocks as Chapter 3 begins, after the opening mission Welcome to Vice City. Pure story progress, unmissable.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Keep playing the main story and it arrives on its own.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by completing its final mission, Starting From Zero. The trophy pops right after that mission ends.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: unlocks after the final mission of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It is the same closing mission that ends Chapter 4, so this gold pops alongside Top Of The World, Ma. After the credits, free-roam stays open for everything else.
trophies.quote: GTABase: finish the last mission; free roam carries on afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run to the end. It is an automatic story trophy, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist to the end. It is an automatic story trophy, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play to the end. It is an automatic story trophy, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners to the end. It is an automatic story trophy, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown to the end. It is an automatic story trophy, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory to the end. It is an automatic story trophy, so it cannot be missed. The story runs to five chapters, and this is the last chapter's story beat.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story. The list only appears once the credits roll, but everything you did earlier already counts. The bar is forgiving, closer to 60% true completion: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts. The parts that must be finished in full are the robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: hardest trophy; about 60% true completion, not a full 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four types however you like: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to pile them up. Track the total under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and keep going to 300, because the 100% checklist wants that many.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: under-the-bridge flights are the quickest; 250 of 397 stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt. Check what is left under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. Most of them turn up naturally while you play the story and open up the map.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: the tracker counts 9 activity types.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds spread across 12 ranges. The ranges also raise your Focus, which makes Gunslinger easier later, so work on this before the combat trophies.
trophies.quote: GTABase: 42 golds across 12 ranges; ranges raise Focus.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 races, so finish each location while you are there.
trophies.quote: GTABase: one win per location; 100% wants all 42 races.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Repeating a race you already won does not count, so keep moving to new race locations.
trophies.quote: GTABase: 20 different races from 40; repeats do not count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui. He will text you and mark a fishing spot west of Key Lento. Play through his fishing quests, then beat him in his fishing challenge.
trophies.quote: GTABase: after Feng Shui, Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game all the way through; side challenges are not required. Three games sit on the TV at home from Chapter 1 (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind) and a fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.
trophies.quote: GTABase: three games on the home TV, one on arcade cabinets.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only, from Chapter 3. Answer Andy's calls and texts, then visit the address in Belville and work through his five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The quests stay available after the story.
trophies.quote: GTABase: five Andy quests in order, Lucia-only, from Chapter 3.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, Kenton calls and a green KR icon appears in Key Lento. Recover treasure from seven shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector. Kenton vanishes for a while after Chapter 1 and comes back in Chapters 2 and 3.
trophies.quote: GTABase: 7 shipwrecks; Kenton returns in Chapters 2-3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Billy has five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the last one unlocks the trophy.
trophies.quote: GTABase: five Billy quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida. Confirmed to count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. The quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count, so watch the trophy's own progress counter to see which strands register. None of them are needed for 100%, and they all stay available after the story.
trophies.quote: GTABase: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses and others do not.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, you get the Key Cloner and deliver a car to Zorrusso. Randy then asks for 16 sports cars, delivered one by one to his garage (RK icon, west Vice City). Use the WAiNK app to check his wishlist, and hunt around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach for the cars.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 16 sports cars to Randy's garage after the Key Cloner mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only, from Chapter 3, after the mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple (quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then play the follow-up quest Spin On This.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Jason-only; destroy the labs, then play Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, tracked under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia together counts double. THE MISSABLE ONE: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That meditation raises the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is still unclear whether it counts toward the trophy, so do it anyway, just in case. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 spots.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: potentially the only missable trophy in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts you and the quest Veteran Hunted starts in Lummox County. Bret hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle; hunt the animal on his Target Deck (purple icon) and bring it back to him. The 100% checklist needs 15 Target Deck animals.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Bret gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three collectible card sets: 18 sets exist, so pick the easiest three. Track sets under Progress, then Collections.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 3 sets of any kind; 18 sets exist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) to scan 100 locations of any kind. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, plus the No Flusher tags. The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this overlaps nicely.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus tags.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so keep pushing past this trophy, and skip the hardest challenges, since 10 can be left undone. Track them under Progress, then Challenges.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 50 of 80 challenges; 100% needs 70.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Play with your partner beside you (available after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; summon them by holding Right and Triangle). Build a four-star wanted level, then escape until you leave the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape route, and this often pops on its own during bank vault robberies.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a reliable escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level: the wanted stars must stay lit (flashing red and blue), not fade into heat. Bring body armor, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline. Three jewellery stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's Jewellery Jobs open in Chapter 3. The trophy can pop about 30 seconds late; if one run fails, the fourth shop still counts as part of the chain.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: pop can be 30 seconds late; a 4th shop still counts.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK: you only need to scan them, not drive them. Busy roads are the fastest hunting ground. The 100% checklist raises the bar to 200 base models, tracked under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: scan only; 100% needs 200 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single use of Combat Focus (L3 and R3 while aiming). Fill the Focus bar by eating, drinking, washing up or using Adrenaline, which also stretches it out. Gang operations are a good stage for it. Police, soldiers and civilians do not count, only gang enemies do. Focus also grows through the shooting range, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: police, soldiers and civilians do not count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge in the VCIA departures terminal, not one parked out on the field. Terminals E3 and E4 are the easiest: slip in through the fence and the stair doors, climb to the cockpit, reverse onto the runway and take off. Fly about a kilometre clear of the airport and the trophy pops.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: terminals E3/E4 are the easiest way in.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, on the island south-west of Mariana County: the tanks sit at the south of the base. Get in through the gate or over the south-east stunt jump, then shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: tanks sit at the south of Mile Zero Air Station.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: You need the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewellery Jobs in Chapter 3. Enter a jewellery store through the back door with the Snap Gun ready: kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Find the vault code note, empty the safe, destroy the CCTV recordings and switch off the alarm. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; the trophy pops shortly after you walk out.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: kicking the door in sets off the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. First play the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is: follow a security van to a bank and slip in while the vault is opened, and bring your partner to split the bags. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 once you have done his quests. Each vault means a four-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and swap vehicles. Five vaults are enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all eight, and a vault can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: up to $205,000 per vault; 100% wants all 8.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape. A bank vault robbery counts toward this too, or do it earlier: ambush a truck near a bank, stick a sticky bomb on the rear door, blow it open and escape the heat zone, or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray. Sticky bombs are sold behind Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: a bank vault robbery also counts for this trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida until the map fog is gone. The fastest way is to fly a plane over the fogged areas and let the map fill in beneath you.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: fly a plane over fogged areas to clear the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs: 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons. The 100% checklist wants all 39, tracked under Progress, then Gangs.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 39 operations, 9 gangs; 100% wants all of them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.target: Apple Martini at Ocean View Rooftop Bar
trophies.guide: Reported by PowerPyx, not fully confirmed: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it beside the bar, overlooking Ocean Beach. GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed, so treat this as the best current report rather than gospel.
trophies.quote: GTABase: exact steps still unconfirmed; PowerPyx reports the rooftop bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.target: Blue Banshee through the showroom window
trophies.guide: Reported by PowerPyx, not fully confirmed: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Then drive it straight out through the showroom window. Only that blue Banshee counts, and the trophy can pop a little late.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: only that blue Banshee counts; pop can be late.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation, marked by the optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling). Grab three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east office (code 0300, or a sticky bomb). The trophy pops once you escape the police. You do not need all three in one visit: the robbery icon respawns after a while.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: safe code 0300; items need not be grabbed in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength for Jason AND Lucia at the same time: check it under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength. Train at a fitness club together (summon your partner first; training one trains the other too), or work out at home after the story. You need your partner available, which starts after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: training one partner trains the other too.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, so every action shows its demon icon. Your profile climbs through Professional, Hardened, Violent and Psycho, and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid it: police get far more aggressive at Psycho and above. Most of the 500 arrive naturally; only farm the last few, carefully.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Irredeemable is permanent; avoid it.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.target: Rob the same Payday Loans twice
trophies.guide: In the prologue, Lucia robs the Payday Loans store. Come back later as Lucia, alone, without Jason, and rob the same store again, then escape ON FOOT, not in a vehicle. You need the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check first, which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. The store is in Little Cuba, Vice City: threaten the teller, deal with the guard, empty the three cash drawers and run until you are out of the search area.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: escape on foot, not in a vehicle.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The UFO easter egg, as reported by PowerPyx: late at night, after 02:00, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car waits at the roadside. It is random, so leave and come back if it is not there. Follow the trail into the woods, approach the UFO in the blue light, and it drops the abducted woman; talk to her, offer help, then walk her back to her car at the roadside.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: after 02:00, alone, north-west of the Starlet Motel.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride a motorbike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded streets in Vice City or Ocean Beach are the place to do it.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: motorbike, Square kick, 10 pedestrians in 60 seconds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. You need the Dye Pack Jammer from the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check. Rob banks and Payday Loans stores, then carry the marked bills to a fence: Yasmani in Vice City pays the best rate. The total is cumulative, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in one hit, so it builds up during the 100% run.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: Yasmani pays the best rate; vaults pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. The fastest route is the expensive stuff: weapons, car mods and tattoos. Leonida has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Spray locations, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 shoe shops, 18 salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: weapons, car mods and tattoos are the fastest spend.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The four story garages do not count. Total cost is around $160,000: robberies in Chapters 3 and 4 pay for it.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: 8 garages, about $160,000; story garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you deliver a vehicle to Moses. Bring stolen vehicles to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and then Register. You need a free garage slot (see Little Boxes). Early on, only vehicles without a tracker can be registered; from Chapter 3 you can also register tracked ones at a Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.quote: PowerPyx: use cheap cars and bikes; registration costs money.
